import random, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from protocol import validate
from te.session import run_case
import gen as G, verify as V

rng=random.Random(5)
nodes=20
# build a dense edge set
pairs=[(u,v) for u in range(nodes) for v in range(nodes) if u!=v]
rng.shuffle(pairs)
edges=[[u,v,rng.choice([1,2,3,5,10,100])] for (u,v) in pairs[:60]]
adj={}
for eid,(u,v,c) in enumerate(edges): adj.setdefault(u,[]).append((eid,v))
coms=[]
for k in range(24):
    s=rng.randrange(nodes); t=rng.randrange(nodes)
    while t==s: t=rng.randrange(nodes)
    slots=[]
    used=set()
    for _ in range(4):
        w=G.random_walk(adj,s,t,rng)
        if w is None or tuple(w) in used: slots.append(None)
        else: used.add(tuple(w)); slots.append(w)
    coms.append({"source":s,"sink":t,"demand":1000,"paths":slots})
case={"nodes":nodes,"edges":edges,"commodities":coms,"workers":[list(range(24))],
      "quorum":1,"max_lag":3,"relax":[3,2],"rho":8,"mode":"route",
      "events":[{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0}]}
req={"cases":[case]}
validate(req)
t=time.time(); resp={"cases":[run_case(case)]}; dt=time.time()-t
errs=V.verify(req,resp)
nv=sum(1 for c in coms for p in c["paths"] if p is not None)
print("vars(non-null slots)",nv,"time %.2f"%dt,"errors",errs[:3] if errs else "none")
case2=dict(case); case2["mode"]="admit"
req2={"cases":[case2]}
t=time.time(); resp2={"cases":[run_case(case2)]}; dt=time.time()-t
print("admit time %.2f"%dt,"errors",V.verify(req2,resp2)[:3] if V.verify(req2,resp2) else "none")
EOF
